narr: A deamplifying mid level shortwave with dewpoints in the 70s and decent instability brought scattered thunderstorms and widespread flash flooding to Massachusetts and Rhode Island. There were many streets closed, many cars stranded in flood waters, and several houses with flooded basements or first floors.
ev: In Leominster, a culvert at Pleasant St and Colburn St washed out the foundation of a house. The residents were evacuated.
In Ludlow, cars were stuck in flood water on Page Blvd and Berkshire Ave.
In Leominster, Pond St at Pleasant St had a sink hold which formed and water rushed in. This washed away part of the road.
In Leominster, Rt 117 had a section of road buckled.
In Agawam, Liberty Street had 1 ft of water on it.
In Leominster, two cars were flooded and disabled.
In Fitchburg, a section of Rt 2 eastbound was flooded to car headlights.
In Agawam, numerous roads were flooded and impassable with water rescues.
In Springfield, there was 3 feet of water in a basement along El Paso St. Blunt Park Rd was impassable with cars stuck. Carew St was closed with 4 feet of water.
In Leominster, multiple homes had to be evacuated including a trailer park of 30 people on Central St.
In Leominster, Rt 2 near Rt 12 was closed due to flooding.
In Leominster, multiple roads was flooded and impassable.
In Fitchburg, cars were stuck in flood waters by the bridge on River St.
In West Springfield, cars were stuck in street flooding on Carando Dr and Weston St.
In Chicopee, East Main St at Broadway St was flooded and impassable.
